edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (Nineteen Old Poems); punctuation is added at the source’s own phrase breaks.
edition.zh: 据维基文库《古诗十九首》，标点依原文断句补加。

basis.en: Anonymous Eastern Han poem, collected in the Wenxuan (c. 530).
basis.zh: 东汉无名氏诗，收于《文选》（约 530 年）。

note.en: From the Nineteen Old Poems. The Herdboy and the Weaving Girl are the stars Altair and Vega, lovers in legend kept apart by the Milky Way. Notice the doubled words: six of the ten lines are built on them, 迢迢, 皎皎, 纤纤, 札札, 盈盈, 脉脉, and they give the poem its slow, looping music. Qin Guan’s lyric on the same two stars, written nearly a thousand years later, is also on this shelf.
note.zh: 《古诗十九首》之一。牵牛与织女是牵牛星和织女星，传说中被银河隔开的一对恋人。留意那些叠字：十句里有六句以叠字起头，迢迢、皎皎、纤纤、札札、盈盈、脉脉，给了这首诗缓慢回环的音乐感。近一千年后秦观写同样两颗星的《鹊桥仙》，也在这个书架上。

excerpt.orig: 盈盈一水間，脈脈不得語。
excerpt.en: Brimming, one stretch of water between them; / gazing, gazing, and no word spoken.
excerpt.zh: 盈盈一水间，脉脉不得语。

gloss.en: The Herdboy star, Altair. In the legend the Herdboy and the Weaving Girl are lovers kept apart by the River of Heaven, the Milky Way.
gloss.zh: 牵牛星，即牛郎星（天鹰座α星）。传说牛郎与织女相爱，被银河隔开。

gloss.en: The girl by the River of Heaven: the Weaving Girl star, Vega.
gloss.zh: 银河边的女子，指织女星（天琴座α星）。

gloss.en: 擢: to raise, draw out; 素, white.
札札 is the click-clack of the loom; 杼 is the shuttle.
gloss.zh: 札札：织机的声音。杼（zhù）：织布的梭子。

gloss.en: She cannot finish a pattern; 章 is the woven design.
gloss.zh: 织不成花纹。章：布帛上的经纬纹理。

gloss.en: Gazing in silence, full of feeling.
